gamefaqs.section: Wii VC Game Save File (North America)

format: raw SNES SRAM, 8192 bytes: the SNES Ys III's save ("Wanderes from Ys (Ys-3) Programed by N.Fujisawa 91-04-24" at 0x20, a string in the SNES ROM, not on the TurboGrafx-CD disc). Not a Wii data.bin; a decrypted VC savedata.bin and an emulator .srm would look the same

verified.converted_with: none needed: the file is already the raw 8 KiB SRAM the SNES cores load; it was copied unchanged as <ROM stem>.srm
verified.baseline: with no save: Start begins a new game (Adol at 20 hit points, 0 experience)
